items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 20 November 2026 9:40pm
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Friday, 20 November 2026 at 9:40pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

A cold start tomorrow with a risk of frost and ice in places.

A dry day ahead with sunny intervals, though getting breezier as the light or moderate southeasterly wind strengthens through the afternoon. Top temperature 10°C.

Comments: Risk of frost and ice at first. Strong winds developing.


##Outlook##

Dry with sunny spells on Sunday, turning cloudier later in the day, with a strong easterly wind easing through the afternoon, becoming moderate in the evening. Top temperature 9°C.

Comments: Risk of coastal overtopping (AM). Strong winds.
